title: Tableau constant vertex
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $b$ be a Boolean value. The tableau constant vertex is $n+1$ if $b$ is true, and $n$ if $b$ is false.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
